Update mediationverse Packages

Source: R/update.R
mediationverse_update.Rd

Updates all mediationverse packages to their latest versions from GitHub or CRAN.

Usage

mediationverse_update(
  packages = NULL,
  ...,
  only_outdated = FALSE,
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

packages

Character vector of package names to update. Default is all core packages.

...

Additional arguments passed to the installation function.

only_outdated

Logical. If TRUE, update only members whose installed version is older than the newest on their recommended source, plus members that are not installed. A member whose newest version cannot be determined (for example offline) is kept. This makes network requests to look up the newest versions. Default FALSE.

dry_run

Logical. If TRUE, print what would be installed and return it without installing anything. Default FALSE.

Value

Invisibly returns a character vector of updated package names (with dry_run = TRUE, the names that would be updated).

Details

This function uses pak::pak() if available (recommended), otherwise falls back to remotes::install_github() for GitHub packages and utils::install.packages() for CRAN packages.

Package sources:

  • mediationverse: GitHub (data-wise/mediationverse)

  • medfit: GitHub (data-wise/medfit) — CRAN has 0.3.2, which predates two result-changing fixes in 0.5.0 (serial te()/pm() and confint(parm = "paths"))

  • probmed: GitHub (data-wise/probmed)

  • RMediation: CRAN

  • medrobust: GitHub (data-wise/medrobust)

  • medsim: GitHub (data-wise/medsim)

  • missingmed: GitHub (data-wise/missingmed)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Update all packages
mediationverse_update()

# Update specific packages
mediationverse_update(c("medfit", "probmed"))

# Only what is outdated, and preview first
mediationverse_update(only_outdated = TRUE, dry_run = TRUE)
} # }
